scenario.summary: Guest adds a bundle at quantity 1, sets the cart quantity to a value above the available quantity and checks the exceeding-quantity message, sets it back to 1, checks out as guest and verifies the included child quantities on checkout, then empties the cart.
steps: Search the bundle SKU and open the first result
Set PDP quantity 1 and Add to Cart
Set the cart quantity to the exceeding quantity; verify 'Exceeding the available quantity.'
Checkout as guest; verify the included products text 'Qty: <n> | <child SKU> - <child name>'
stateChanges: Guest cart: the bundle is added, its quantity changed, then all items are removed (no order placed)
assertions: Cart quantity error equals 'Exceeding the available quantity.'
Checkout shows the included child products with their bundle quantities
evidence: Method comment: Z10-TC-8999 exceeding product quantity error message, Z10-TC-9000 included quantities, Z10-TC-9001 remove all.

What drives the message (read-only, znode10-api-migration PublishProductService): GetPublishProductPriceAndInventory -> CheckBundleProductsInventory(selectedQuantity) -> CheckBundleProductInventory per child: combined = (selected + cart quantity) x child AssociatedQuantity (bundle quantity); a child with OutOfStockOptions DisablePurchasing and stock < combined (or DontTrackInventory with combined outside its Minimum/MaximumQuantity) fails, and with selectedQuantity > 0 the bundle gets WebStore_Resources.ExceedingAvailableWithoutQuantity 'Exceeding the available quantity'.

Key PRODUCT_BUNDLE_QUANTITY_LIMITED_IN_STOCK {store, quantityUsed 1, exceedQuantity 5} with a drafted query: every active child has store stock >= quantityUsed x bundle quantity, and the lowest floor(stock / bundle quantity) over DisablePurchasing children (output availableQuantity) is below exceedQuantity. The DontTrackInventory min/max branch is not used.
AddToCartQuantity '5' is the exceeding quantity: config tied to exceedQuantity (the migrated test can also set availableQuantity + 1).
The literal '1' quantities (PDP and cart reset) are config.

FreeBundleProduct (ProductInfo2) is composed 'Qty: <childNBundleQty> | <childNSku> - <childNName>' per child (recorded: z-2671004 x2, z-2672001, z-2672003); data without output, built from child1..3 outputs.
Profile: z-345678 not profiled (no Playwright test uses it).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
